verdict.rationale:
Gecko's docs claim AI-generated insights — severity, confidence score, call chain, PoC, and suggested patch — surfaced directly in the product (gecko-security-docs-2, docs-3), which is the core of the story. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the reliability of these AI insights: a 100%-confidence finding turned out to be false (comm-3), a real vulnerability was missed entirely (comm-4), and another flagged 'vulnerability' was judged nonsensical/inaccurate (comm-5), undermining trust in the AI-generated suggestions themselves.
missing for 10: independent validation of accuracy/precision, resolution of the false-positive/missed-detection reports, clearer error handling around scan failures.
